paragraphs: Gevihah son of Pesisa, in the days of Alexander of Macedon. Sanhedrin 61a.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: Hyman cites סא., rendered Sanhedrin 61a. The corresponding Gevihah ben Pesisa episode before Alexander of Macedon is at 91a in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic. A name search of the retrieved 61a text found no Gevihah/Pesisa match; this is bounded to that returned text. The source locator remains unchanged.

Pesisa is a conventional vocalization. The source explicitly gives the son relationship and Alexander-era setting; the digital comparison does not establish where the locator discrepancy originated. Earlier machine OCR had a comma after סא rather than the supplied period.

The 61a nonmatch is the earlier bounded name-check report; the newly read whole matching passage is the named 91a paragraph, not a fresh inspection of all of 61a. Neither check proves where Hyman’s locator discrepancy arose.
